verdict.rationale: Figma's official MCP server docs explicitly describe extracting variables, components, layout data, frames, screenshots-to-code, and Code Connect mappings for IDE-based coding agents, and a live runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint (mcp.figma.com) is real and speaks MCP/OAuth. REST API docs (variables, webhooks, library analytics) further back this with a machine-readable OpenAPI spec confirmed live via probe. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer report specifically validating the fidelity of MCP-extracted design context in a real coding-agent workflow
